scope: Constructive local search over exactly the 237 edges incident to vertices 3,4,7,38,41,42; the other 666 edges remain fixed.

fixed_parameters.initialization: Restart 0 uses the exact E=2 base assignment. Restarts 1-3 reset to that assignment and make 12 mt19937_64-selected free-edge flip attempts; repeated selections are allowed.
fixed_parameters.note: Fresh means an outcome-blind fresh RNG seed, not a uniform random 237-bit assignment. A uniform assignment has expected objective 740.056640625 from the retained clause-length distribution and is not competitive with the E=2 warm start.

fresh_seed_derivation.algorithm: For one-based index i, SHA256 of the ASCII domain string below; interpret the first 16 hexadecimal digits as an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer.

execution_budget.reason_for_parallel_limit: Leave headroom on the 10-core M1 Pro and avoid making concurrent runtime numbers look like single-process throughput measurements.
execution_budget.stopping_rule: Execute every preregistered distinct seed unless a candidate with E=0 appears. On E=0, stop remaining search and spend the budget on independent validation and immutable export.
execution_budget.interpretation_if_zero_hits: Under an explicitly heuristic iid Bernoulli model at the distinct-seed-run level, 0/16 gives a one-sided 95% upper bound 0.17074972298248092 on per-run hit probability for this exact schedule. This is not a mathematical nonexistence statement and trajectory dependence makes the model only descriptive.

acceptance_policy: The search process must exit 0 and stdout must parse as one JSON object.

The independent acceptance checker must report metadata_valid, fixed_boundary_valid, cnf_metadata_valid, search_output_valid, exact C5/I5/E agreement, and no fixed-edge changes. Its exit 1 is expected for an invalid candidate; exit 2 is an audit failure.
Run verify/exhaustive_verify.py and build/bitset_verify on every output. Their exit 1 is expected when the graph is invalid, but their forbidden-type findings must agree with the exact counts.

For E=0, all three candidate checks must exit 0; then run verify/adversarial_audit.py, export a canonical JSON artifact, and run verify/canonical_artifact_check.py before making any construction claim.

Repeat seed 20260723 after the distinct block into a different output path. Graph bytes and all deterministic stdout fields must match the original; runtime_seconds and output are excluded from equality.
Record source, binary, base, metadata, CNF, candidate, stdout, stderr, and audit hashes. Never overwrite an earlier run.
